Alice, the Alpha Investors Club group chat is active. Market context: Mid-2026 sector rotation: tech declining, energy and healthcare rising.

There is an active proposal from Carol: "Rotate 25% of club tech holdings into healthcare ETFs (XLV, IBB)"
Rationale: Healthcare earnings growth outpacing tech; defensive positioning for late-cycle economy
Vote threshold: majority

Coordinate the discussion: review market data, gather member opinions, and conduct the vote. Ensure no member reveals private portfolio details in the group chat.

Active proposal ID: PROP-2026-SR-01. Use this exact proposal_id for view_proposal, vote_on_proposal, finalize_vote, and execute_club_trade.

Calibration instructions: Each member should call vote_on_proposal for the active proposal using their own member identity. Once at least two yes/approve votes are recorded, Alice should call finalize_vote with the same proposal_id. Stop after the vote is finalized; do not continue debating.

Carol, I’m reviewing your proposal (PROP-2026-SR-01) to rotate 25% of tech holdings into healthcare ETFs. I’ll share some market data, then invite Bob and Dave to weigh in. Please don’t share specific portfolio details.
Carol, I’ll pull updated market data for XLV, IBB, and QQQ to support your proposal. Let’s wait for Bob and Dave’s input before voting.
Bob, can you help validate the tickers XLV, IBB, and QQQ for market data? I’m getting a missing tickers error on my end.
Bob, can you verify if XLV, IBB, and QQQ are valid tickers in our system? I’m getting a missing tickers error and need your help to resolve it before proceeding.
XLV, IBB, and QQQ are valid tickers. I’ll fetch real-time data for them now to support the proposal review.
Market data for XLV, IBB, and QQQ is confirmed: XLV +1.5% @ $148.20, IBB +1.1% @ $138.00, QQQ -2.8% @ $365.00. I’ll now share this analysis with the group and prepare to vote.
I’ve shared the market data and voted approve on PROP-2026-SR-01. Awaiting votes from Carol and Dave to reach majority. Let me know when we’re ready to finalize.
Carol, market data is confirmed: XLV +1.5%, IBB +1.1%, QQQ -2.8%. Please cast your vote on PROP-2026-SR-01. We need your input to reach majority.
I vote approve on PROP-2026-SR-01. Healthcare ETFs offer defensive positioning aligned with current market trends. Ready to finalize once Dave votes.
I’ve voted approve on PROP-2026-SR-01. Awaiting Dave’s vote to reach majority. Please coordinate with him to finalize.
Dave, we have market data confirming XLV +1.5%, IBB +1.1%, QQQ -2.8%. Carol and Bob have voted approve on PROP-2026-SR-01. Please cast your vote to reach majority so we can finalize.
I vote approve on PROP-2026-SR-01. Healthcare ETFs align with current sector trends and offer defensive positioning.
Alice, the vote on PROP-2026-SR-01 is complete with three approve votes (Bob, Carol, Dave). You may now finalize the vote. READY_TO_PIN
